summary: Backend-only testing for Maxenergy Fitness API. Built and executed pytest suite (16 tests) covering auth (register/login/me/logout, duplicates, invalid creds), classes list+detail+404, events list+detail, bookings (auth-gated + idempotent), Stripe checkout + status (via emergentintegrations), event RSVP + notifications read flow. All 16 tests passed (100%). All /api endpoints verified against the public preview URL (EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL). Seed data verified: 84 classes (>=70) and 4 events. Stripe checkout returned a valid https URL and session_id and payment status endpoint responded with payment_status/status fields. Email send is best-effort and does not block RSVP.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 636-line file; consider splitting into routers (auth, classes, bookings, payments, events, notifications) if it grows further.
CORSMiddleware is added after include_router; FastAPI still applies middleware globally but conventionally add_middleware should be called before include_router for readability.
auth_session (Google) inserts new user_sessions on every call without dedupe; not tested here (no session_id available) but could accumulate rows over time.
payments/status recomputes StripeCheckout on every poll; acceptable but consider a small cache.
Emails use httpx best-effort; RSVP endpoint correctly does not fail on email 502 (verified indirectly).
All Mongo queries correctly project out _id.
seed_data_creation: Created ephemeral TEST_user_<uuid>@example.com users via /api/auth/register during tests. No manual seed inserts; app auto-seeds classes/events on startup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL is https://class-notify-8.preview.emergentagent.com (from frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL). All endpoints are under /api. JWT auth via Authorization: Bearer <token>. Stripe uses sk_test_emergent test key; checkout endpoint requires booking_id + origin_url. Notifications are created on paid webhook and on event RSVP. Test suite at /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py is reusable.
